purpose: Continue survival iron-pickaxe progression on the isolated Folia stage and diagnose the remaining furnace placement blocker.

changes_after_observations: Placement confirmation now rechecks server block state after Mineflayer placement timeouts.
Furnace placement searches nearby floor and visible side-face supports, avoids player collision, and can route without digging to the previously verified surface worksite.
The survival client waits up to 60 seconds for nearby chunk columns instead of using Mineflayer's fixed 10-second, 25-column wait.
limits: At the time of these four attempts the latest placement changes had not been rerun; later server-confirmed mining, smelting and saved pickaxe completion are recorded in follow_up.
No iron-pickaxe completion, six-resource survival production, StarSupply Folia compatibility, or client resource-pack rendering is claimed.
These failures do not invalidate the prior successful mining and smelting evidence dated 2026-11-22.

follow_up.scope: Later two-plugin acceptance confirmed server crafting and a saved survival pickaxe; full Folia support and six-resource survival production remain incomplete.
